title: Cohomology transport through the constant restriction colimit
statement: For a nonempty directed preorder I, a family of opens V_i in T, a common subspace E, and an ambient abelian sheaf A, use the explicitly constant diagram with value A restricted to E and the inverse-image composition identifications at every stage. Under the canonical constant-colimit isomorphism, every canonical spectral-limit cohomology map is the ordinary projection pullback followed by cohomology of the inverse-image composition isomorphism.

source.place: Tags 01F7, 01F8, 03F3 and 0A37; restriction-system setup for Tag 0A3D(2)

proof.text: A nonempty directed preorder is connected. Its constant diagram has the constant value as a colimit, with identity legs. Colimit uniqueness defines the coefficient isomorphism, and the coprojection followed by that isomorphism is the identity.

The inverse adjunction Hom bijection cancels the transpose in the definition of the cohomology f-map. Naturality of the cohomology presheaf moves a coefficient map through restriction; functoriality combines coefficient arrows. The coprojection identity then makes this composite precisely the inverse-image composition isomorphism.
